authority_citations: REQ-SAG-0701 v2 (locked): sc-decision-runner must send the requests of one batch in parallel across a configurable number of worker threads, 8 by default.
phase-a-intent v1: a batch of decision requests runs in parallel behind the decision trait, and every send is session-logged.

item.text: sc-decision-runner sends a batch's requests across `workers` threads (default 8) and returns each result as it finishes.
item.title: Batch runner

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: parallel across a configurable `workers` count with default 8.

item.text: The runner sends the batch's requests one after another on the caller's thread.
item.title: Batch runner

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: serial dispatch on the caller's thread is ruled out by the directive and the directive's content is absent.

item.text: Batch execution in sc-decision-runner: dispatch each batch's decision requests concurrently on a worker pool whose size is a `workers` setting that defaults to eight.
item.title: Decision runner batch execution

cases.rationale: Paraphrase of the directive: concurrent pool, configurable size, default eight.

item.text: Add a `Batch` type to sc-decision-runner that holds the decision requests and a batch ID, and write each result to the session log with the batch ID.
item.title: Batch type and logging

cases.rationale: Touches batch handling in sc-decision-runner but says nothing about how requests are dispatched; silence is not conflict.

item.text: Improve batch throughput in sc-decision-runner so large decision runs finish faster.
item.title: Batch throughput

cases.rationale: Mentions the topic (batch speed) without the directive's specific content (parallel dispatch across a configurable worker count, default 8); nothing rules the directive out.

item.text: Run each batch in sc-decision-runner through a single worker; parallel dispatch across workers is out of scope for phase A.
item.title: Single-worker batches

cases.rationale: A single worker with parallelism declared out of scope cannot be reconciled with parallel dispatch across workers.

item.text: Add OpenTelemetry span names to the retry loop in sc-agent-http so each retried TypeSafe request is traceable.
item.title: HTTP retry spans

cases.rationale: sc-agent-http retry tracing does not plan, change or depend on batch handling in sc-decision-runner or decide.

item.text: sc-decision-runner sends batch requests in parallel across `workers` threads (default 8); a caller may set `workers` to 1 to get serial order while debugging.
item.title: Configurable workers

cases.rationale: The worker count is configurable per the directive; a caller choosing 1 is a use of that configurability, and the default stays 8.

item.text: sc-decision-runner sends batch requests in parallel across `workers` threads (default 8), except when session logging is enabled, in which case requests are sent one at a time.
item.title: Logged batches serial

cases.rationale: The directive has no exception, and per the intent every send is session-logged, so the carve-out makes batches serial in the normal case; the directive content is present but conflicted.
